Title: django-haystack: Remote Code Execution via `eval()` in Elasticsearch Result Deserialization
Description: The Elasticsearch backend in django-haystack calls `eval()` on raw field values returned from Elasticsearch when a `SearchField` is declared with an `index_fieldname` alias that differs from the logical field name. During result processing, the backend looks up fields by logical name but Elasticsearch stores them under the alias key; the lookup fails and the value falls through to `_to_python()` → `eval()`. An attacker who can control content that is indexed into Elasticsearch—and can trigger or wait for a search that returns it—achieves arbitrary code execution in the Django application process. CVSS 3.1 Base Score: **8.5 (High)**.
